entries.title: Narrator: "As he tried to scramble to his feet..."
entries.dialogueText: As he tried to scramble to his feet, gunfire tore through the air, and he crumpled to the ground, dead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I continued moving, the bookshel..."
entries.dialogueText: As I continued moving, the bookshelves kept me concealed, and before I knew it, I reached the spiral staircase.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo followed my lead, and we man..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo followed my lead, and we managed to slip away. Before long, we were just a few feet away from the staircase.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We should double back. Without any..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should double back. Without any cover, we'd be sitting ducks."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hesitated, realizing that any mov..."
entries.dialogueText: I hesitated, realizing that any movement upward would surely leave us dangerously exposed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hesitated, realizing that any mov..."
entries.dialogueText: I hesitated, realizing that any movement upward would surely leave us dangerously exposed.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Do what you like, but I'm not stay..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do what you like, but I'm not staying here a minute longer than I have to."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo hurried up the stairs. Shots..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo hurried up the stairs. Shots were fired at him, however, I didn't wait to see if managed to evade.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We need to proceed with caution. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to proceed with caution. Who knows what's waiting for us if we make a run for it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright, let's go!""
entries.dialogueText: "Alright, let's go!"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Agreed. No point being too hasty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. No point being too hasty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I ducked and weaved my way through..."
entries.dialogueText: I ducked and weaved my way through the bookstack. Doing so kept us concealed, and before long, we'd reached the spiral staircase.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""After you, *Your Majesty*.""
entries.dialogueText: "After you, *Your Majesty*."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I ignored his sarcasm as we dashed..."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored his sarcasm as we dashed for the staircase.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "However, we were soon spotted, and..."
entries.dialogueText: However, we were soon spotted, and a guard unleashed a volley of shots in our direction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He missed. We didn't stop until we'..."
entries.dialogueText: He missed. We didn't stop until we'd reached the stairs.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Seizing the moment, we dashed for t..."
entries.dialogueText: Seizing the moment, we dashed for the book vault.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He missed. We didn't stop until we'..."
entries.dialogueText: He missed. We didn't stop until we'd reached the vault door. With the combination clicked into place, Adarfo and I entered.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""This was a mistake. I should've kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was a mistake. I should've known better than to trust a monarch."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sank into a chair, waiting for th..."
entries.dialogueText: I sank into a chair, waiting for the upheaval outside to end, while Adarfo paced about. Minutes felt like hours.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We’re still alive. That's more tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "We’re still alive. That's more than you can say for your stupid movement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don’t mistake our situation for a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don’t mistake our situation for a failure. We’ll find a way to come out on top."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We may die, but the revolution nev..."
entries.dialogueText: "We may die, but the revolution never will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why don’t you keep complaining? Su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why don’t you keep complaining? Surely, that’ll solve everything."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo abruptly slammed his hand ag..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo abruptly slammed his hand against a shelf.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I realized what was happenin..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I realized what was happening, Adarfo threw me against the floor and had me by the throat. I struggled to fight back, but his grip was unrelenting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everything began to turn black. But..."
entries.dialogueText: Everything began to turn black. But it was at that moment that I heard the doors to the vault click open, followed by a loud commotion.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The only thing we’re coming out of..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only thing we’re coming out of is this vault, when they decide it’s time to drag us out."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When I came to, my stomach sank as..."
entries.dialogueText: When I came to, my stomach sank as I found myself looking up at Titus, flanked by several guards holding rifles. Adarfo lay nearby, not moving.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And that's exactly what happened. A..."
entries.dialogueText: And that's exactly what happened. As if on cue, we heard the gunfire subside and the sound of the door unlocking.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without warning, Adarfo charged tow..."
entries.dialogueText: Without warning, Adarfo charged toward our guests, screaming and waving his fists, before he was gunned down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It took a moment for my hearing to..."
entries.dialogueText: It took a moment for my hearing to recover and make out what Titus was saying.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Step out of the vault and follow m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Step out of the vault and follow me, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I rushed upward, the dizzying speed..."
entries.dialogueText: I rushed upward, the dizzying speed of my ascent distorted the frenzy below as Adarfo and I escaped the library’s violent interior.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cool night air greeted us as we..."
entries.dialogueText: The cool night air greeted us as we spilled out from the rooftop exit and hurried to the fire escape leading down to the alley.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We should take the fire escape.""
entries.dialogueText: "We should take the fire escape."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Jumping would be our safest option.""
entries.dialogueText: "Jumping would be our safest option."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I'm not about to put myself at..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I'm not about to put myself at the mercy of an angry mob or risk plummeting to my death. I'm going back inside."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Yes, it does seem like the best ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it does seem like the best chance to avoid detection."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I realized that I had to face the c..."
entries.dialogueText: I realized that I had to face the consequences of my choices head-on.
entries.menuText: Go back inside to face the consequences of your choices.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned around and went back insid..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned around and went back inside.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's no honor in running away...."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no honor in running away. I'll be perceived as a coward. I have to go back and face the consequences of my actions head-on."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Then you're a fool. There's only p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you're a fool. There's only possible way that will turn out. And I'm not about to let that happen to me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without a second thought, Adarfo ga..."
entries.dialogueText: Without a second thought, Adarfo gave himself a running start before leaping to the other rooftop. He took one last look at me before vanishing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I, on the other hand, turned back a..."
entries.dialogueText: I, on the other hand, turned back around and went inside. I then made my way down the stairs until I emerged back into the main hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without a second thought, Adarfo ga..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked back and nodded his farew..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked back and nodded his farewell before taking off, vanishing without a trace.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""If you want to take the fire escap..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want to take the fire escape, be my guest. But I'll stick to where it's actually harder to get caught."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stopped when I spotted two House..."
entries.dialogueText: I stopped when I spotted two House security guards crouched behind an overturned table, exchanging gunfire with the Wruhec's Guardians.

entries.dialogueText: I stopped when I spotted two of Adarfo's men crouched behind an overturned table, exchanging gunfire with the Golden Guard.
